items: Farming: every pull is now in the log ("Pulling Locus Dire Bat with Glutinous Dart (12 yalms)"), so you can see when and with what it pulled.

Farming with DO NOT MOVE on: a mob right in front is fought from where you stand - it used to be skipped with "can't get any closer" (farming tried to step up to it, the button stopped the step, and that looked like being stuck). Mobs up to about 7 yalms count as within reach without a pull (flying mobs hover a bit further out).

Farming: you control the respawn timer ("next Locus Dire Bat in ~32 s") - Respawn timer on the Farming tab: learned from your kills (as before, with the learned times shown and a Forget button), set by hand (30 s to 16 min), or off. It's saved with farm spots too.

New: Weapon skill chain for one character (like the AutoSkillchain addon), on Job & abilities. Pick up to 6 weapon skills; they're used in turn - each at 1000 TP or more, at least 4 seconds apart, from melee range (22 yalms for a ranged weapon skill) - and repeat, or stop at the end. A new mob, or 20 seconds without the next one, starts it over. Your chains saved in AutoSkillchain (for that job and weapon type) can be loaded with one click. Saved per job.

Bard: the 5th song is kept up. The extra slot from Clarion Call stays open after Clarion Call wears off as long as its song is sung again in time - the bard used to stop counting it after 3 minutes and the 5th song dropped.
Bard: when several songs are due (a NiTro refresh), the one closest to running out is sung first, and the bard only waits for NiTro if it can sing every song again before the first one runs out.
Bard: a song of yours dispelled while another bard's song of the same kind is on you is now noticed and sung again.

Farming: a big "DO NOT MOVE" button at the top of the Farming tab. While it's on, Vanguard never moves that character - no walking to mobs, back to camp, following, closing in or stepping around. It still pulls, fights and casts at whatever it can reach from where it stands (its pull's reach, or right next to it); the rest are left until they come.
Bard: with Clarion Call up and 3 dummy songs set, only 2 dummies are sung - Clarion Call's extra slot takes a normal song. It used to sing a 3rd dummy for nothing each time.

Farming with a pull and "let it come to me": target the mob, pull it (Provoke, a spell...) from where you stand and wait for it. "Bring each mob back to camp" no longer makes the farmer run out to the mob and back first.

Farming: if the pulled mob stops just out of reach (a hovering bat), the farmer steps in after a moment so its attacks and weapon skills land - it used to stand still and resend the weapon skill every few seconds.

Farming: with a pull set and "Then: let it come to me", the farmer no longer runs off to get a far mob within reach of its pull - it only pulls mobs its pull reaches from where it stands (about 19 yalms for a spell, 23 for a ranged attack, 15 for an ability) and waits for the others to come closer. Mobs that attack it are still fought.

Farming: with "Then: let it come to me", the farmer now really stays put after pulling - it faces the mob and fights it where it is. A melee job's own "close in on the target" used to override it, so it walked to every mob it pulled.

Bard: Marcato is no longer wasted on a dummy song. If a dummy became needed right after Marcato (an interrupted cast or a dispel at that moment), the dummy used Marcato up; now the Marcato song goes first and the dummy right after.

Bard with another bard in the party: your bard no longer mistakes the other bard's songs for its own. It used to (with Minuets / Marches from both bards on it) skip a song of its own thinking it was up, sing one again too early, or take another bard's song wearing off as its own.
Bard: a song dispelled right after it landed is noticed at once (it could be thought "on" for minutes).

Aftermath: "Keep Aftermath" next to the weapon skill on Job & abilities - Off, Lv.1, Lv.2 or Lv.3, and which weapon skill gives it (your Mythic / Empyrean / Relic weapon's). Without that Aftermath up (or with under 8 seconds left), the character saves TP to 1000 / 2000 / 3000 and uses that weapon skill; with it up, it uses its normal weapon skill at the usual TP.

Farming: "Pull with" lets you pick the kind - walk up, ranged attack, job ability, blue magic or other magic - and then exactly which ability or spell, from everything the character can use (for a Blue Mage: the blue spells it has set).
Blue Mage: blue magic that's learned but not set is no longer treated as castable (the game refuses it).
Bard: NiTro can go up any time, not only in a fight - pick "any time (also before the pull)" next to the NiTro tick box on the Songs tab. The default stays "when the party is fighting".
Bard: after a reload or update during Soul Voice (or Troubadour), the songs already sung under it are picked up instead of all being sung again.
Bard: right after a reload it waits a few seconds before the next song, so it doesn't send one while the last cast is still going (the game ignored it).

Bard: a Pianissimo song (say Ballad on a healer) that a party song refresh knocks off that member is sung again within seconds - the bard now checks the member's buff icons. It used to stay off much longer (25-40 % of the time with short songs in the bard simulator).
Bard: tested in a new bard simulator (the game's song rules, an hour of play, 150 random bards with dispels, zoning, KOs, Soul Voice, interrupted casts). It found and fixed four problems:

- A harp's extra song slots need dummy songs to open. With fewer dummies than extra slots, the bard tried to keep songs it couldn't hold and kept knocking them off (180+ songs in half an hour). It now sings 2 + your number of dummy songs and tells you how many dummies the harp needs.
- With two Minuets (or two Marches) on and one dispelled, it sometimes sang the wrong one again first. It now reads the game's timers to tell which one went.
- With two Minuets, it could mix up which one had how long left (when one was sung under Troubadour) and let one run out.
- Soul Voice: the bard waited for NiTro instead of singing the songs again under Soul Voice, and Soul Voice ran out with one song done.

Geomancer: the Geomancy tab has a "Bubbles now" box - which luopan is out, its HP, how far it is from its mob (red when the mob is outside its reach), your own Indi, and who carries the entrusted Indi.

Bard: how long each song really lasts (read from the game - your song gear changes it) is now remembered across reloads and updates, so refreshes stay on time right away instead of going back to the "Songs last" slider. The Songs tab lists these real lengths under Timing.
Geomancer: Entrust is kept up like your own Indi - out of fights too, so the party member has it before the pull. It used to wait for a fight to start.
Geomancer: Entrust waits until that member is alive and within 20 yalms. It used to go off for someone out of range, and the Indi then failed - wasting a 10-minute ability.

Bard: after a zone change (songs come off everyone who zones), the Pianissimo songs on party members are sung again right away. The bard used to think they were still on and waited out their old timers.

Geomancer: the luopan goes where the spell can go. Enemy bubbles (Frailty, Malaise...) always go on the mob; a party bubble (Geo-Regen, Geo-Haste...) with "Place the luopan on" left on the first choice goes on the leader (or on you). Picking a party bubble without changing the target used to have the game refuse it every few seconds. The first choice is now called "Automatic".

Bard: the Songs tab has an "On now" box - the songs your bard has on right now and its Pianissimo songs on party members, each with the time left and a NiTro tag for songs sung under Troubadour. A missing or short song is easy to spot.

Geomancer (and every caster): spells on the mob aren't sent while it's out of casting range (about 21 yalms) - it says so and waits. The Geo bubble used to be sent every few seconds from too far away ("too far away" each time, no bubble), and Blaze of Glory went off for nothing.
Geomancer: the Dia cast first to get on the mob's hate list is no longer skipped when the mob started out of range.
Bard: after a reload or an update, Pianissimo songs a party member already has are picked up instead of all being sung again.

Geomancer: picking another Indi spell (or another Entrust spell) in the app takes effect right away - the new one is cast over the old. It used to wait for the old Indi to wear off, which could take minutes.
Debuffs (Carnage Elegy and other bard songs, Dia, Slow...): when one wears off the mob in a long fight, it's cast again. Once it had landed it used to count as done for that mob for good.

Geomancer: Blaze of Glory only goes off when the Geo spell can follow right away (a Geo spell is set, it's ready, you have the MP, and there's a mob for an enemy bubble). It used to go off whenever there was no luopan in a fight and was often wasted.

Bard: when Soul Voice goes up (by Vanguard or by you), every song - and the Pianissimo songs - is sung again once under it, so they get its double strength. Songs already on used to stay as they were, so Soul Voice did nothing for them.
Geomancer: Life Cycle waits for the luopan to run low (under 50 % HP) instead of going off on a full-HP luopan, where it did nothing. Change the % in the ability list ("luopan HP <").

Bard: Pianissimo songs (one song on one member) are kept up like the bard's own songs. They count once the song lands - an interrupted or out-of-range song is tried again within seconds instead of minutes later.
Bard: Pianissimo songs use the real song length (gear, Troubadour doubles it), are sung again under NiTro, and are sung again right away when the member is KO'd or the song is dispelled.

Geomancer: the luopan is moved when it isn't reaching anyone. Its bubble only reaches about 6 yalms, but it used to be recalled only 15 yalms from the fight - so when the next mob was 7-15 yalms away, the whole fight happened outside the bubble. Now Full Circle and a new bubble on the new mob.
Geomancer: a party bubble put down on you or a member (Geo-Regen, Geo-Haste...) is moved when that person walks out of its reach, and picking a different Geo spell replaces the luopan right away.

Bard: Nightingale, Troubadour and Clarion Call now go off when anyone in the party is fighting. A bard that leads ("Nobody (I lead)") and stands back used to never see a fight, so they never went off.
Bard: Clarion Call (ticked under Job & abilities) goes up right before the songs when your list has a 5th song.
Bard: "How many songs" stops at 4 - the 5th song needs Clarion Call. Set to 5 without it, the 5th song kept knocking another one off and the bard sang the same songs over and over.
Bard: a song that drops off right after it lands isn't sung again for a minute, with a message saying so, instead of looping.

Bard songs reworked after Ivaar's Singer and the bg-wiki bard guides. The bard now keeps track of exactly which of its songs are on: a new song with every slot full replaces the one with the least time left (a dummy first), the same song replaces itself, and songs that wear off or get dispelled are sung again (with a dummy first when the harp's slot closed).
Bard: dummy songs only when a harp slot is empty - a refresh or NiTro with all songs still on just sings each song over itself.
Bard: songs now come right after raises, cures and status removal - before steps, sambas, Elegy and other abilities - so the Troubadour minute isn't used up by other things.

Bard: Nightingale, Troubadour and Marcato ticked in the ability list are left to the songs while Songs is on (they used to go off on their own and the songs missed them). If you use Nightingale + Troubadour by hand, every song is sung again under them.
Bard: Clarion Call is in the ability list (off until you tick it): +1 song while it's up.

New: Send logs (App & updates > Problems). Everything in the app's log - the app, each character's Vanguard messages and updates - is now also kept in vanguard_log.txt next to the app. Send logs opens the same report page as Report a problem and puts your last 100-2000 log lines on the clipboard: click in the report box, press Ctrl+V, say what went wrong, click Submit. Character names and your Windows user name are replaced first.
Bard: after NiTro, every song is sung again even if Troubadour runs out part way (it used to leave the rest on their old, shorter timers - two 10-minute songs and two 5-minute ones).
Bard: when all your songs are still on, the NiTro refresh sings them over themselves and skips the dummy songs, so all 4 fit inside Troubadour.
Bard: new "Sing all songs again now" button under Timing, and "Sing again this long before they wear" goes up to 180 seconds.

Bard: songs that are already up when Vanguard starts (sung by hand, by another addon, or before a reload) are picked up with the time the game says they have left, instead of all being sung again. A song that wears off early or is dispelled is sung again right away.

Bard: NiTro (Nightingale + Troubadour) is used as soon as it's ready in a fight when your songs weren't sung under it, so they last the full doubled time. When songs come due and NiTro is only seconds away, the bard waits for it instead of singing them plain.
Bard: each song's real length is read from the game (song gear, merits, Troubadour), so songs are refreshed just before they really run out.
Bard: a song your bard hasn't learned is skipped with a message saying so (it used to be skipped silently), and the dummy songs work out their place from the songs you can actually sing.
Bard: "Songs last" goes up to 900 seconds (long-duration song gear lasts past 600).
Fix: on a brand-new install, //lua load vanguard failed with "libs/config.lua:344: attempt to call method 'update' (a table value)". It loads now (your update settings are kept).
Vanguard Control.exe has its own icon now (the gold shield) and shows its name and version in Windows.
New download: one zip at the top of the GitHub page - unzip it and double-click the exe, nothing to install.
Fix: after removing a reaction or a farm spot, listing reactions or loading spots could hit an error (the same cause as crash report #1).
Past runs starts with today's totals: runs, farming time, kills (and per hour) and the loot found most.
Farming: pulling with a ranged attack and out of ammo? It says so (the alarm rings) and pulls by walking up and attacking for the rest of the run.
Past runs: a × on each run takes just that one out of the history (and out of Best spots).

Fix: Past runs and Best spots showed the wrong place and mob (where you ended up after Abyssea time ran out, and the first mob on the list). Runs are now saved with the zone they started in and the mob killed most; very short runs with no kills aren't saved.
Vanguard Control looks for its own updates every hour instead of every 6 hours, so new features reach the open window sooner.
Farming: when only 3 inventory spaces are left, it can ask Steward to tidy the bags (one sort pass) so farming goes on. Tick it under Stop when.
Fix: the finishing weapon skill kept holding TP with no trials left ("Help finish it" still pointed at a removed trial).
The Abyssea time alarm rings at 10, 5 and 1 minutes and 30 seconds only.

Finishing weapon skill: now only while a Magian trial needs that mob - with no trial, weapon skills go off as usual (TP isn't held back). Untick "Only when a Magian trial needs that mob" for the old way.
Fix: pet jobs no longer try to call their pet (Activate, Call Beast, summons) over and over in towns, where pets aren't allowed.
Fix: after removing a Magian trial, farming hit an error every second (crash report #1) and its stop checks didn't run.

Magian trials remember the trial weapon (the one in your main hand when you add the trial). Farming with another weapon rings the alarm - those kills won't count - and Vanguard doesn't count them either.
Abyssea: starting to farm without Visitant status rings the alarm (you'd be sent out in a few minutes), and the farming checklist shows it.
Farming tab: Best spots - your past runs grouped by zone and mob, with kills, XP, CP and loot an hour, the best spot first.
A farming run's summary and Past runs now show what it did for your Magian trial, e.g. "Buzzfly +100 (100/100)".
Fix: a finished Magian trial rang the alarm twice.
Magian trials: when a trial you're farming for is done, farming stops and the app's alarm rings - with or without "Help finish it". Can be switched off under Stop when.
Auto finishing weapon skill can go a little higher when mobs keep dying first: up to 2% above its strongest hit or the highest HP it has killed from.
Vanguard stops when you change zone or change job (main or sub) - farming too. Press Start / Run again when you want it. Both can be switched off under Farming > Stop when.
Fix: before the trial weapon skill, Vanguard could stop attacking much too early on a new kind of mob (from 60%). It now holds off only 5-10% above the point where the weapon skill goes off.
Magian trials: while you farm, the trial box says how long is left at this pace - e.g. "about 1 h 11 min to go (about 120 more kills)" - from your kills an hour and how often a kill counts.
Abyssea: in the last minute of Visitant time farming doesn't pull another mob (being sent out mid-fight wastes the kill); mobs already on you are still fought.
Fix: the Abyssea alarm rang every second for the last 10 seconds. It rings once for the final seconds now.
Auto finishing weapon skill can now go off earlier when mobs keep dying first - up to its strongest recent hit instead of a typical one.
Fix: "Stuck: stepping around" no longer shows up after a weapon skill or spell (you can't walk while it goes off).
Magian trials: holding off for TP before the killing blow now works for every mob an open weapon skill trial needs, even without clicking "Help finish it".
Fix: the Abyssea time alarm rang every minute with plenty of time left. It now rings only when 10 minutes or less are left.
Farming carries on after you're sent out of a zone (like Abyssea time running out): come back to the same zone within 15 minutes and it starts again by itself. On by default under Stop when.

Farming in Abyssea: when the game warns that your Visitant time is running out, the app's alarm rings ("Farming: Abyssea time: 5 minutes left"), so you can top it up before you're sent out. On by default under Stop when.

Auto finishing weapon skill tunes itself: when mobs die before it goes off, it goes off 2% earlier next time; when it goes off but doesn't kill, 2% later (never past a typical hit). It remembers the tuning.

Magian trials: the trial box now says why the weapon skill missed a kill - the mob died in one go from above your %, TP wasn't ready, or the weapon skill went off but didn't kill - and suggests a higher or lower %.

Magian trials: pick at what % of the mob's HP the trial weapon skill goes off, right in the trial box (or leave it on Auto, which shows what it learned). Finer steps: 3, 5, 8, 10, 12, 15, 18, 20 % and up.
Holding off for TP before the killing blow now also works with a % you picked.
Fix: trusts are no longer called while a mob is fighting you - including when you've stopped attacking (holding off for TP) or a mob is going for someone in the party.

Fix: Auto finishing weapon skill could learn from one weak hit and wait until the mob was nearly dead (normal hits then got the kill). It now goes by the typical hit, and remembers what it learned across reloads and updates.

Magian trials: more kills land with the trial weapon skill. While helping a trial, the finisher stops attacking a little before the mob is low enough when TP isn't ready yet (the others hold off too), and attacks again at TP 1000. The trial box shows how often the weapon skill landed the kill this session.
Fix: "Help finish it" no longer switches the finishing weapon skill from Auto to a fixed 30%.
Fix: after every update or reload, each job's setup (which actions are on, the menus, and whether farming was on) could reset to the defaults. It's now kept, and farming carries on after a reload.
Shield Bash, Palisade and Reprisal are only used with a shield in your off hand (not while dual-wielding).
An ability or spell the game refuses ("That action requires a shield.", "Unable to use job ability.") is paused for a while instead of retried every few seconds; the activity log says so.
Paladin: Crusade, Phalanx, Enlight II and Reprisal are no longer re-cast while they're still up, and Flash no longer goes off twice in a row.

Fix: kills still showed 0 while farming in the real game. A mob your party claimed that falls dead is now counted as a kill directly, so kills, kills per hour, past runs, respawn times and Magian trial counts work.

Finishing weapon skill: new "Auto: when one hit would kill it". It learns how much of each kind of mob one hit takes and holds TP until the mob is that low, so the weapon skill lands the kill instead of being used too early.
While a finishing weapon skill is set, reactions that fire the same weapon skill (like "TP 1000 or more: Atonement") wait - the TP is kept for the killing blow.
Fix: abilities your current job / sub job can't use (Warcry or Provoke left switched on from /WAR while you're /DNC) are no longer tried.

Fix: a reaction with a weapon skill (like "TP 1000 or more: Atonement") no longer fires between fights - weapon skills wait until you're engaged, and anything aimed at the enemy waits until there is one.
Fix: farming that picked a lone mob could still attack one standing in a group when the game's target-nearest landed on it.

Farming learns respawn times: after a mob it killed comes back, it knows how long that spot takes, shows "next Apex Bat in ~40 s" while it waits at camp, and won't move on to another spot when one is about to pop.
Farming can stop at a level: under Stop when, pick "or when <character> reaches level N". Handy for levelling a job - it stops (and does your "When done") the moment the level is reached.

Farming looks further when it's quiet: under Where, pick "When it's quiet, look further, up to ...". After 30 seconds with nothing to fight it searches 10 yalms further, step by step up to your limit, and goes back to your normal range once mobs are close again.
Fix: farming's "leave mobs near other players alone" never saw players outside your party, and the bard's nearby-player song list missed them too. Both now recognise other players correctly.
Rare drop alert: pick items under Stop when ("Ring when one of these drops") and the app rings the moment one drops while you farm.
Farm spots can be copied to your other characters: "copy to..." next to each saved spot sends its mobs, camp or route and settings over in one click.
Farming shows roughly what your loot is worth - and gil per hour - using the auction-house prices Steward has looked up (if you use Steward).

Fixed: kills, XP and CP were never counted in the game (farming showed 0 kills). The game sends those in a message Vanguard wasn't reading. Kills per hour, the mob report, Magian trials, chains and "stop after N kills" all work now.
Farming emergency: pick a potion (from your bags) or a defensive ability like Sentinel or Chakra, and the farmer uses it when its HP drops under the % you choose during a fight. Under How to fight.
Farming key: pick Ctrl+F9 (or F8, F10, Alt+F9) on the Farming tab, then start, stop and resume farming from the game window with one key press.

New: Magian trials on the Farming tab. Add a trial by clicking (defeat N mobs, or with a weapon skill), watch the progress bar, and click "Help finish it" - farming fights the right mobs, finishes them with the trial's weapon skill and stops when the trial is done.

Fixed: farming switched itself off after a couple of minutes. Each Vanguard update reloaded your characters and the reload started them switched off. Now a character that was running or farming carries on after an update, and the app waits to update a character that's in a fight.

Farming leaves a mob alone when another player is standing right next to it (they're about to pull it) and takes a different one - fewer lost claims, and polite. You can switch it off under What to fight.
Farming is a little lighter on the game (it checks the bags once a second, not constantly). The Vanguard page on GitHub has a full farming guide.
Farming shows in the game too: the Vanguard box on screen gets a line with what the farmer is doing, kills, kills per hour, your item goal and the XP / CP chain.
Behind the scenes: 230 random farming sessions were played out in the simulator (different mobs, settings and spots) - no problems found.
Farming: ❚❚ Pause and ▶ Resume. Stop for a moment (to trade, talk or move) without ending the run - the numbers carry on and paused time isn't counted.
When a run ends, a short summary appears in your game chat: time, kills, kills per hour, XP / CP and loot.

Farming can /check each new kind of mob once before fighting it, and skip the ones that are Too Weak (no XP) or Incredibly Tough / NMs. Turn it on under What to fight (the XP / CP party quick setup does it for you).
Each kind's check result shows as a coloured tag, and next to it in "Which mob is worth it".
Farming protects the party: between pulls, a mob hitting your healer (or any other party member) is dealt with before one hitting the farmer.
"The team right now" on the Farming tab shows every character's HP, MP and what they're doing, without switching tabs.
Fixed: when the farmer asked another character to rest (low MP), that character could rest to full and never stand up again, so farming waited forever. It gets up by itself now.
Farming rests at camp while there's nothing to fight, and gets up the moment a mob turns up - less waiting after fights.
Save TP: choose "no weapon skill on a mob under 15% HP" (How to fight) so TP isn't wasted on a mob that's about to die.
Fixed: a character low on HP that got attacked kept trying to sit down and rest instead of fighting back. Now nobody rests while a mob is attacking the party.
Farming claims faster: with a pull set (ranged attack, Provoke, a spell), the farmer uses it as soon as the mob is in reach instead of walking up first - so it's yours sooner and comes to you.
The Farming tab now opens in a Simple view with just what you need; "All settings" shows everything.

Behind the scenes: a farming simulator now plays out whole farming sessions in the tests (walking, walls, claims, rests, routes), so problems like "not moving to attack" get caught before they reach you.
Farming: spot rotation. Save a few farm spots in a zone and tick "move on to the next saved spot" - when one runs dry for 3 minutes, the farmer walks to the next.
A small chart shows kills per 5 minutes over the last hour, so you can see when a spot slows down.
The checklist now warns when a spot is busy (most mobs belong to other players) and when Reraise or food is missing.
Farming checklist: green ticks and red crosses show exactly why the farmer is or isn't pulling - mobs picked, camp set, mobs nearby, party ready, resting, bag space.
Treasure Hunter: tick it (or use the Item farming quick setup) and GearSwap tags each mob with your TH gear while farming.
The radar can zoom (Fit, 30, 60, 120 yalms). New tiles: CP per hour and free bag spaces.
Farming: Quick setups. One click sets everything for an XP / CP party, item farming, safe and careful farming, or clearing everything around the camp.
No more getting stuck on a mob: if the farmer is fighting something it can't reach (no damage for 25 seconds, out of reach) or someone else claims it, it lets go and moves on.
Farming: Past runs. Every farming run is kept at the bottom of the Farming tab - how long, kills, kills per hour, XP / CP, loot and why it stopped.
Too strong: a kind of mob that takes your farmer under 25% HP or over 3 minutes (twice), or KOs it, is set aside automatically. It shows in purple on the radar; click ↺ to fight it again.
Extra mobs joining a fight: one click and everyone who can sleep them will.
Farming is steadier: the farmer no longer gets pulled back by following or assisting someone else, it helps a party member who gets attacked, and it stops cleanly if it changes zone.
⚡ Quick start: one click farms the most common mob around you, with the camp where you stand.
Click a mob on the radar to fight that kind or leave it alone.
Stop after a set time, and choose what happens when done: stay, everyone warps home, or everyone logs out. The Alarms ring when farming stops or has had nothing to fight for 5 minutes.
Trusts are now sorted by role in the trust menu: Tank, Healer, Support, Melee, Ranged, Caster.
Farming: XP / CP chains. The Farming tab shows your chain number, how long since the last kill and your best chain. Vanguard learns how long the chain window is from your own kills.
"Keep the XP / CP chain going" (under The team): while a chain is running, it only waits for the party in a real emergency (HP under 40% or MP under 15%), so the chain doesn't break.
Farming: "Which mob is worth it". While you farm, Vanguard learns how long each kind of mob takes to kill and how much XP / CP it gives, and shows the best one with a star.
Tick "Prefer the mob that pays best" and when several mobs are near, it goes for the kind that gives the most points per minute.
Farming: bring each mob back to camp. Tick it under Where - the farmer pulls, runs back to camp with the mob following, and fights it there.
Your other characters wait at camp instead of running out to the mob, and join in when it arrives (like a real FFXI party puller).
Farming: see what dropped. The Farming tab now shows "Loot this run" - everything that came into your bags while farming.

Farm for an item: under Stop when, pick an item (from your bags or what dropped) and how many - e.g. 12 Beastmen's Seals. A progress bar shows how close you are, and farming stops by itself when you have them.
Fixed: picking a weapon skill (like Atonement) on Job & abilities turned weapon skills off and the menu jumped back. It sets the weapon skill now.
Farming: "Fight mobs within" now goes up to 500 yalms (in steps of 50 after 50).

Farming fix: the farmer now walks to its mob. Before, when the mob was far away it kept trying to attack from where it stood and never moved. Now it walks up, attacks once it's close enough, walks right up if that didn't work, and skips a mob it can't reach instead of getting stuck on it.

Farming: avoid packs. A mob with others standing next to it can bring them along, so the farmer now picks mobs on their own first. Farming tab > How to fight (on by default, pick how close counts as "next to it").
"Never pull one with others next to it" makes it wait until a mob is alone; those show purple on the radar. Mobs already attacking you are always fought.

Farming rebuilt from the ground up. The Farming tab now opens with a live radar (your camp, the mobs coloured by what farming will do with them, your party) and the run's numbers: time, kills, kills per hour, a kill every N seconds, XP per hour.
It stays in one place: a camp it returns to after each kill (or a route you record). Mobs it can't reach (can't see them, can't get closer) are skipped instead of chased forever.
It waits for the party before each pull - the healer's MP, everyone's HP, everyone close - and tells whoever is low to rest. "Others follow and help" sets the whole team up in one click.

Three ways to farm: mobs you pick, only what attacks you, or anything nearby. Stop when the inventory is full or after a number of kills. Save the whole farm as a spot and load it next time with one click.
Fixed: drop-down menus (like "Finish with") closed by themselves before you could pick something. They stay open now.
Fixed: red "bridge error ... vg_bridge.lua:98" lines filling the chat every second (from the new Cooldowns box). Cooldowns work now.
Fixed: Geomancer's "Dia first" (get on the hate list before a Geo debuff) never happened in game. It does now.
If something does go wrong talking to the app, it's shown once a minute and listed under App & updates > Problems instead of filling the chat.
New: Cooldowns on the Team tab. Every character's job abilities on one screen: green ones are ready - click one and that character uses it - grey ones show the time left.
"Only the long ones" keeps it short: 1-hour abilities and the ones with long recasts (Sentinel, Convert, Elemental Seal...).

Farming redesigned, EasyFarm-easy: it has its own Farming tab now. 1) What to fight - Look around and click Fight these. 2) Where - how far to look, and an optional route you record by walking it. 3) How - pull with Provoke, Flash, a ranged attack or just walk up, and when to rest. Then one Start farming button.
The top of the Farming tab says what it's doing right now: going for a mob, fighting, resting, walking the route - or that you still need to pick what to fight.
Farming also has 4) Trusts - click the trusts to call between fights - and "Walk up to the mob before attacking".

New: Finish mobs with a weapon skill (Job & abilities and Farming tabs). Pick e.g. Atonement and the HP% - the character saves its TP and lands that weapon skill as the killing blow. The other characters stop attacking that mob when it gets low, and a tank can wait for TP if the mob gets low too early.
Fixed: automatic updates could get stuck on an old version ("Access is denied"). The window also refreshes by itself after an update.
Fixed: a character could show "running" right after loading even with Auto start off. Now only Auto start starts it by itself.
Fixed: deleting a saved team setup could bring it back later.

Fixed: "Something went wrong (event action / ipc message / incoming text)" messages filling the chat. Since the crash-report version, Vanguard's events lost their details in game, so the characters couldn't react to fights, each other or chat. Everything works again.

New: Go home on the Team tab. Warp everyone, just the alts, or one character home with two clicks. Each character uses what it has: the Warp spell, an Instant Warp scroll, or a Warp Ring (put on, used when it's ready, and GearSwap kept off the ring until it zones).
The box shows each character's way home, and "none" in red if it has no way to warp.

New: Alarms. The app plays a sound, shows a red banner and flashes the character's card when one of your characters is KO'd, asleep, petrified or charmed, goes offline (disconnected), or is stuck behind or not fighting. It works even while the app is minimized behind the game.
Low HP and low MP alarms too (tick them and pick the %), and "Keep ringing until I click OK" for when you step away. App & updates > Alarms; Test sound to hear it.
Logging out with the Log out button or the stop timer doesn't set it off.

New: Enemy watch on the Team tab. See what your characters are fighting: its HP, distance, the TP move it readies, and every enfeeble - green landed, yellow being cast, red resisted, grey not tried yet.
When two characters fight the same enemy it shows once, with everything both of them know.

New: keep MP for cures (an idea healer tools like CurePlease share). Healing & MP / Recovery tab: "Keep MP for cures" - below that MP the character stops casting buffs, songs, enfeebles and nukes, and saves the rest for Cures, Raise and status removal. Off (0) unless you set it.
The Vanguard page now says it plainly: Vanguard is free and always will be - no paid features, subscriptions, keys, ads or donations.

New: Skillchain builder on the Team tab. Pick each step's character and weapon skill from menus (only weapon skills that character has); the app shows each one's properties, what every step makes (e.g. Gravitation, then Darkness) or "no skillchain", and which magic bursts it opens. "Use this skillchain" sets it on everyone.
No more typing "Character:Weapon Skill" lines.

New: crash reports. Errors in the addon (on any character) and in the app are now caught instead of breaking things, with exactly where they happened. A "problem" badge appears at the top; App & updates > Problems > Send report opens a ready-made report on the Vanguard GitHub page - click Submit and it reaches the developer so it can be fixed.
Character names and your Windows user name are replaced before anything is shown or sent, and nothing is sent without your click. "Report a problem" works for things that go wrong without an error.

New: Upkeep table on the Team tab - for each character, pick the food to keep up, how to keep Reraise up and which mount to ride, from menus of what that character really has (food in its bags, the Reraise spells it can cast and Reraise items it owns, the mounts it owns). No more typing item names.
This was the last of 10 hourly updates researched from paid tools (ISBoxer, MMOMinion and the paid script programs).

New: share profiles with friends (paid tools like MMOMinion have profile downloads). On the profile bar, Export… saves a profile as a file with the normal Windows Save window; Import… adds a file a friend sent you.
Exported files leave out which character they came from and who the leader is; an imported profile never overwrites one of yours (it becomes "Name (2)").

New: Reactions builder on the Advanced tab (like the skill editors in paid tools). Pick When (my HP / MP below, TP at least, someone's HP below, the enemy's HP below, the enemy readies or casts something it was seen using, I have / don't have a buff, fighting or not), Do (a spell, ability, weapon skill or item, on whom) and How often - all from menus.
Reactions are listed in plain words with an x to remove them, and are saved properly now.

New: pick farm mobs by clicking (like MMOMinion's grind lists). Advanced tab > Farming > Look around lists the mobs near a character - how many, how close, who claimed them - with Fight these / Leave alone buttons. No more typing mob names.
The farm lists show as tags with an x to remove; a mob is on one list or the other, never both.

New: hotkeys for quick buttons (like ISBoxer's key maps). Give any quick button Ctrl or Alt + a number from a menu; pressing it in the game window you play makes that button's character act - no need to click the app.
Hotkeys are set in the leader's game window by default (you can pick another), and are removed when the button is.
New: ability priority, like MMOMinion's Skill Manager. The Job tab lists the abilities in the order they're tried - top first - with up / down / to-the-top arrows next to each one, and Reset order.
The order is saved per job and travels with profiles.

New: Stop timer on the Team tab (paid script programs call it "stop after run time"). Pick "after 2 hours" or "at 3 AM", then whether to just stop or stop and log out, for everyone or only the alts. A countdown shows at the top.
It runs in the app, so it works with the window minimized; logging out uses the normal /logout.

New: Party board on the Team tab - every character's HP, MP, TP, what it's doing and all its buffs in one place, so you don't need to look at the other game windows (the job ISBoxer's window views do).
Ailments show in red, also on the character cards on the left. Click one and a character who can cure it casts the right spell (Paralyna, Cursna for Doom, Erase, ...).

New: quick buttons (like ISBoxer's click bars). On the Team tab pick who, what (a spell, ability, weapon skill, item, attack, follow or stop) and on whom - all from menus - and it becomes a button in a bar at the top. One click makes that character do it, without switching windows.
Buttons can be for one character or everyone, moved left / right and removed.

New: session stats for every character on the Team tab - experience, Capacity Points and limit points per hour, kills, deaths and time. Reset starts a new session. (Paid tools like MMOMinion and the RuneScape script clients all show these.)
New: this What's new tab, so you can see what each update adds or fixes.
Bard: a third dummy song, so with 5 song slots (Daurdabla + Clarion Call) it sings 2 songs, the 3 dummies, then songs 3-5.
Bard: 5 song menus and a "5 songs" option; under Clarion Call all 5 songs are sung.
Bard: Honor March and Aria of Passion show up when you own Marsyas / Loughnashade.
Bard: "+ Add someone" for Pianissimo songs (alliance members, your other characters, players nearby).
New: Auto start switch at the top (off by default) - characters only start by themselves when it's on.
Bard: the dummy song menus are always there.
Bard rebuilt after the Singer addon: song slots from your harp, dummy songs, Marcato before the song you pick, the Clarion Call song, Pianissimo per member, waiting for the party to be in range.
Stratagems: one grid - tick which spells get Perpetuance, Accession, Celerity, Penury and the rest.
Healing: tick which Cure and Curaga tiers are used, and pick the HP amounts from menus.
Fixed: the red "is not defined for strings" error on Scholars.
Fixed: switching a character to Scholar now shows up in the app.
New: Scholar stratagems for SCH main job and /SCH - charges by level, a reserve for emergencies, Light / Dark Arts kept up.
New: profiles like CurePlease - save a character's whole setup, load it on anyone, or have it load by itself for a job.
New: thresholds next to every ability, cure tiers, rest / Convert / Sublimation settings.
The app installs and updates the Vanguard addon by itself; Team tab with every team order.
